newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to publish cellular bid terms Tuesday - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to publish cellular bid terms Tuesday - paper.

text.p: Brazil's Communications Ministry will publish next Tuesday the bid terms for the upcoming privatization of Brazil's Band B cellular services, Folha de Sao Paulo daily said on Friday.
The rules will be subject to public hearings for 15 days and may suffer changes, the newspaper said.

Prior to the publication of the tender details, the Brazilian government will publish a new presidential decree regulating the country's cellular services. The decree, which was first published on Nov 20, will include changes suggested by the market, Folha said.
The newspaper also said the Communications Ministry expects to start the tender process by the end of this month.
